definition: means Medical Expenses incurred during pre-defined number of days immediately after the insured person is discharged from the hospital provided that: a. Such Medical Expenses are for the same condition for which the Insured person's hospitalization was required, and b. The In-patient hospitalization claim for such hospitalization is admissible by the Insurance company.
plain: Follow-up costs after discharge — review consultations, medicines, physiotherapy — for the same condition you were admitted for.
whyItMatters: The window is longer than most people expect, often 60 to 180 days, and it is where recovery costs actually land. It is also tied to the same condition: a follow-up for something unrelated that happens to fall inside the window is not covered. Claim it as one file with the hospitalisation, not as an afterthought.
